bismillah.english: In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

ayahs.english: The Most Merciful
Taught the Qur’ān,
Created man,
[And] taught him eloquence.
The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: And the stars and trees prostrate.
And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
That you not transgress within the balance.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
ayahs.translit: wa-aqīmū l-wazna bil-qis'ṭi walā tukh'sirū l-mīzāna
ayahs.english: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: And grain having husks and scented plants.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
ayahs.translit: wakhalaqa l-jāna min mārijin min nārin
ayahs.english: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
[He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
He released the two seas, meeting [one another];
Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
ayahs.translit: walahu l-jawāri l-munshaātu fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlāmi
ayahs.english: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.arabic: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
ayahs.translit: wayabqā wajhu rabbika dhū l-jalāli wal-ik'rāmi
ayahs.english: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
ayahs.translit: yasaluhu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi kulla yawmin huwa fī shanin
ayahs.english: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
ayahs.translit: yāmaʿshara l-jini wal-insi ini is'taṭaʿtum an tanfudhū min aqṭāri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi fa-unfudhū lā tanfudhūna illā bisul'ṭānin
ayahs.english: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
ayahs.translit: yur'salu ʿalaykumā shuwāẓun min nārin wanuḥāsun falā tantaṣirāni
ayahs.english: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
ayahs.translit: fa-idhā inshaqqati l-samāu fakānat wardatan kal-dihāni
ayahs.english: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

ayahs.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
ayahs.translit: fayawma-idhin lā yus'alu ʿan dhanbihi insun walā jānnun
ayahs.english: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
ayahs.translit: yuʿ'rafu l-muj'rimūna bisīmāhum fayu'khadhu bil-nawāṣī wal-aqdāmi
ayahs.english: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: hādhihi jahannamu allatī yukadhibu bihā l-muj'rimūna
ayahs.english: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
Having [spreading] branches.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
In both of them are two springs, flowing.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ
ayahs.translit: muttakiīna ʿalā furushin baṭāinuhā min is'tabraqin wajanā l-janatayni dānin
ayahs.english: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِنَّ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
ayahs.translit: fīhinna qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi lam yaṭmith'hunna insun qablahum walā jānnun
ayahs.english: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinnī -
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
As if they were rubies and coral.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
Dark green [in color].
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
In both of them are two springs, spouting.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
In them are good and beautiful women -
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

ayahs.arabic: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
ayahs.translit: lam yaṭmith'hunna insun qablahum walā jānnun
ayahs.english: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

ayahs.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍ
ayahs.translit: muttakiīna ʿalā rafrafin khuḍ'rin waʿabqariyyin ḥisānin
ayahs.english: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
ayahs.word_integrity_warning: API word marks differ from verse text

ayahs.english: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
ayahs.translit: tabāraka us'mu rabbika dhī l-jalāli wal-ik'rāmi
ayahs.english: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
